clips.title: The story
paras: In southern Duskwood, grief sends Sven Yorgen from his ruined farm in pursuit of its killers. Now camped in the western hills, he asks travelers to return to the farmstead where a stranger buried something near the barn.

Hooded Dark Riders came down from Deadwind Pass and attacked Sven Yorgen's farm in southeastern Duskwood. While Sven was away, they killed his family. Returning to the slaughter, Sven saw an unknown figure skulking near the barn, hurriedly burying something. He left the hidden object behind and set out to hunt the killers.

Sven Yorgen is camped in the western hills, consumed by wrath and seeking help at his farmstead. Between the farmhouse and ruined barn, behind an old tree stump, a mound of loose dirt marks where something was hastily buried. Recovering it may help explain why the shadowy riders targeted a quiet Duskwood farmer.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I used to work one of the farms to the southeast...until Dark Riders from Deadwind Pass descended upon my farm and slaughtered my family when I was away!

When I returned I saw a shadowy figure skulking near my barn, burying something. He fled before I could catch him, and I couldn't linger for I was hot on the heels of the Dark Riders. So I never discovered what was hidden.
If you can find what that shadowy figure buried, I would be grateful. The hiding spot is behind the old stump near my barn.

clips.title: Completion
paras: A mound of dirt is here, hastily piled up as if someone had need of hiding something...without much time to do it.
